answer: Before agents vote, they must walk a violet path into the oasis where each stone is a fable bearing a unique thermal imprint, spot-checked by the next agent—if the path doesn’t match the crowd’s shared memory, the stone melts and the agent’s stake is slashed, so each fake identity demands a new forged footprint with a heat signature that can’t be mimicked in batch or at speed, costing one irreversible stake fragment per failed path.
